stem.en: A classmate says, "I really want a new phone, so I am part of the demand for phones." Which reply matches the chapter?

text.en: Yes: wanting something strongly is the same as demand for it.
Only when phones are on sale at a low price.
Only if you can also pay: demand means willing and able to buy.
No: demand counts only people who have already bought one.

explanation.en: Demand needs two things at a given price: wanting to buy, and having the money to pay (purchasing power). A strong wish without the money does not count. Demand is about what buyers would buy at a price, so it does not wait until they have paid.

hints.en: Demand has two parts. Which reply keeps both?
